    A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

    Let’s clear
    things up.

    Can you work with our existing tools?

    Usually, yes. We assess your current apps, available integrations, and API access first. The aim is to connect what already works for you and identify any gaps before agreeing the scope.

    Will automation replace my team?

    The first goal is to remove repetitive workload. Your people still handle relationships, judgement, and exceptions. Depending on the process, automation can help you manage more activity without hiring additional staff for routine tasks.

    How much does an automation cost?

    Pricing depends on the workflow, integration complexity, and support you need. After learning about your business, we provide a scoped quote and explain any ongoing software or usage costs before work starts.

    How do you handle sensitive business data?

    We agree which data a workflow needs, who can access it, and which tools will process it. Access should be limited to what is necessary, with approvals and review steps designed around your business requirements.

    What happens on the demo call?

    We discuss your current process, walk through a relevant automation example, and identify a practical starting point. Share the tools you use and the tasks taking up your team’s time so we can make the conversation useful.
